description: The bar chart visually compares the Token Ratio (TR) performance of three Korean language models — RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) — across six evaluation categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The horizontal axis lists these categories in order, while the vertical axis, scaled from 0.0 to 1.0 with 0.1 intervals, represents the TR score. For each category, three vertically aligned bars display the performance of the respective models: dark purple for RedWhale, light blue for EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and light gray for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base). SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) consistently achieves a perfect TR score of 1.00 in all six categories, visually dominating as the tallest bar in every group. RedWhale’s performance varies across categories, starting at 0.42 in PT-EVAL and improving to 0.69 in KoBEST-SN, with its highest score of 0.73 observed in KoBEST-CP. EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 begins at 0.46 in PT-EVAL, peaks at 0.74 in KoBEST-CP, and dips to its lowest of 0.50 in KoBEST-HS. In the final AVG category, RedWhale scores 0.61, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 scores 0.57, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) again reaches 1.00, confirming its consistent superiority. The chart visually emphasizes the performance gap between the base model and the two fine-tuned models, while also highlighting RedWhale’s generally stronger and more consistent performance compared to EEVE across most tasks.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the Token Ratio (TR) performance of three models across six categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The vertical axis ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick intervals of 0.1. Each category contains three bars representing RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base), respectively. Notably, SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 consistently outperforms the other models across all categories, achieving a perfect score of 1.00 in each case. RedWhale demonstrates a steady improvement across the datasets, with its highest performance observed in KoBEST-SN (approximately 0.73). In contrast, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 shows a decline in performance from KoBEST-BQ to KoBEST-HS, where it achieves its lowest score of 0.50. On average, RedWhale slightly surpasses EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, with a mean score of 0.61 compared to 0.57.
